surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the deposition of Ru nanocrystals through atomic layer deposition (ALD) using bis(ethylcyclopentadienyl)ruthenium (EtCp)2Ru and O2 gas. The ALD process utilizes a surface-saturated reaction mechanism, which allows for precise control and reproducibility. The formation of Ru nanocrystals on the Al2O3 surface is facilitated by the ALD process, which ensures uniform growth and high spatial density.
